tool.name: task-output
tool.description:
Reads the status and captured output (tail) of a background task started with runInBackground=true.
**Parameters**: - `taskId`: the id from the `[BACKGROUND_TASK started taskId=...]` confirmation.
**Semantics**: - Returns the task status (RUNNING / COMPLETED / FAILED / TIMEOUT), total byte count, and the captured output tail (last 8KB). - Idempotent and repeatable — reading never consumes the result; the completion notification is separate and arrives exactly once. - An unknown taskId returns an explicit error (in-memory registry; ids do not survive a process restart). - Tasks submitted by another session are refused (same-session default). - Not subject to activeTags filtering (meta tool).
